title: DEP-SEC: close #280 TS7 bump; ignore typescript >=7; keep TS6 path
intent: Dependabot #280 (typescript 5.9.3→7.0.2) is unlandable on the current client toolchain (vue-tsc/@volar/typescript ERR_PACKAGE_PATH_NOT_EXPORTED for ./lib/tsc; @typescript-eslint v6 Intrinsic failure; Vue SFC regressions). Close it, ignore only typescript >=7.0.0 so a future typescript@6 upgrade prepared by #284 remains possible, and record durable disposition.
behavior_change: Intake-only. No packages/client TypeScript version change. Dependabot will not open typescript >=7 PRs.

diff_articulation.what_changed: Add dependabot ignore for dependency-name typescript versions >=7.0.0. Add disposition document with Copilot risk completion, @volar/typescript chain, landing criteria, and sibling issues (#282/#283).
diff_articulation.why_not_redundant: Ignoring all typescript majors would also block the intentional TS6 path from #284. Version-scoped ignore is the minimal durable control. #280 itself cannot be merged.

commands_run: gh pr view 280 → OPEN, mergeStateStatus UNSTABLE; typescript 5.9.3→7.0.2
rg typescript/lib/tsc in packages/client (excl lock) → no repo-local importer
PR #284 body already records #280 unlandable (vue-tsc / eslint / compiler-sfc)

files.intent: Stop Dependabot from regenerating typescript >=7 bumps while allowing TS6.
Authoritative #280 risk disposition and migration criteria.

architecture_scan.acknowledgement_notes: Does not upgrade TypeScript. Does not upgrade vue-tsc or eslint. Closing #280 retains the TS6 migration path from #284. Sibling Dependabot majors #282/#283 remain out of scope for this patch.
